description: Executable form of the applicability conditions named in intake/config/profile_schema.json. Phase A named them and left expression null; this file supplies the predicate. Evaluation is deterministic application code (intake/backend/services/applicability_service.py) - never an LLM, per intake/SPEC.md section 6.

operators.any: At least one child predicate is true.
operators.profile: Compares a field on the org profile, e.g. industry_overlay_id.
operators.answer: Compares a field of another datapoint's recorded answer. scope selects which instance: 'same_site' matches the site being evaluated, 'org_wide' matches any instance in the org.
operators.self_answer: Compares a field of this datapoint's own recorded answer. Used by rules that fire on the answer just given.

industry_is_film.description: The client's industry overlay is the film production overlay (SEED-1.4).

more_than_one_legal_entity.description: The org comprises more than one legal entity. Skipped entirely for single-entity SMEs.

unresolved.reason: No intake question currently establishes whether the client has more than one legal entity, so this reads a profile flag that defaults to false (the mapping's stated common case: single-entity SMEs). Raised with the founder; a screening question may be needed.

prior_inventories_exist.description: The client has prepared a GHG inventory before, so base year is a real choice rather than the SME default.

stationary_or_mobile_fuel_present.description: Fuel is burned somewhere - stationary equipment, a generator, or a vehicle fleet - so blend composition matters.

screening_answer_negative.description: A screening question was answered 'no'; the completeness rule records 'screened, not present' rather than an exclusion.

mobile_fleet_present.description: The client owns or leases vehicles or motorised equipment (S1MOB-4.1 positive).

selling_energy_or_attributes.description: The client sells self-generated power or its environmental attributes, creating double-counting risk (OPB-040).

answer_is_yes.description: The client answered 'yes' to this data point's own screening question.
